title: Abre Dreamina y en AI Video selecciona Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0…
content:
Abre Dreamina y en AI Video selecciona Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0 para generar video con referencias multimodales.  
Sube materiales de referencia (imágenes/videos/audio/texto) y combina hasta 12 archivos a la vez para guiar la generación.  
Usa “@” dentro del prompt para asignar qué material de referencia debe usar Seedance en cada parte.  
Escribe la instrucción describiendo explícitamente la escena y el movimiento antes de generar.  
Usa una secuencia de imágenes tipo storyboard como referencia base para estructurar el video en planos conectados y mantener coherencia entre escenas.  
Acompaña el storyboard con un prompt centrado en el estilo visual y la dirección de las acciones para reforzar consistencia de look y comportamiento.

en.content:
Open Dreamina and in AI Video select Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0 to generate video with multimodal references.  
Upload reference materials (images/videos/audio/text) and combine up to 12 files at once to guide the generation.  
Use “@” within the prompt to assign which reference material Seedance should use in each part.  
Write the instruction explicitly describing the scene and movement before generating.  
Use a storyboard-like sequence of images as a base reference to structure the video into connected shots and maintain coherence between scenes.  
Accompany the storyboard with a prompt focused on the visual style and direction of actions to reinforce consistency of look and behavior.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Thanks to its multimodal capability, Dreamina Seedance 2.0 can integrate and understand different types of materials in a unified way, achieving more stable, coherent results that are closer to a real creative process.  
It's very simple:

1. Open the Dreamina website👉: https://t.co/7RKtJ8Sf1j
2. Enter AI Video and select Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0
3. Upload your reference materials (images/videos/audio/text, up to 12 files at once)
4. Use “@” in the prompt to assign the use of each material
5. Write your generation instruction (describe the scene and movement)
6. Click generate

[Thread 2] In this test, I used a storyboard-like sequence of images as a base to structure the video, along with a prompt focused on the visual style and direction of actions.

With this type of input, the result develops as if following a defined camera language: each shot naturally connects to the next, the characters' identity remains unchanged, and the elements within the scene retain their composition and stability.  
Overall, the final video feels like a continuous visual narrative built from the storyboard, with a coherent style and no breaks between scenes.

[Thread 3] If you want to try it yourself, you can experiment directly in Dreamina to see the result.  
👉: https://t.co/OeYX3tFqSJ
